purpose: Mechanism diagnosis only: center-strong smooth proxy curves, not measured Xbox spring laws or production adoption.
theta_source: Existing common motion envelope 23 degrees; joint-coordinate radial normalization, not hardware curve measurement.

formula.elastic_component: tau_i=-K_eff*q_i; estimate only, not solver total effort

drive_update: Every pre-step including linear: set_drive_properties(K_eff, original damping, original force_limit, mode=force), both tested tilt axes share K_eff; target stays0. No qf torque substitute, no q/qvel write.
unchanged: CPU TGS, dt .004s, gravity, 10/1 original solver iterations, collisions/mass/inertia/cone, click -7.4N + K1000 target0, original tilt damping and force limit, other-side joints. Original cone force/point/timing and scoring reused.
mechanism_hypothesis: Stronger centering near zero with the same nominal endpoint effort reduces residual angle at fixed friction and all other settings.
scoring: Original cone runner remains authoritative; <=.1deg and <=.01rad/s return gate unchanged. No multiplier search.
overshoot_observation: Release-start q vector from final loaded state defines positive direction. Maximum negative q projection during release, converted to degrees, is joint-space reverse overshoot. Also report unsigned total-angle peak and max absolute tilt joint speed during whole release. Not an added acceptance gate.

sources.local_reference: references/left_stick.json: reference14mNm /23deg is a linear equivalent estimate, not measured pure spring torque.
sources.supervisor_checked_ALPS: https://tech.alpsalpine.com/e/products/detail/RKJXV122400R/ ;14+-10mNm and return precision+-5deg refer to reference component, not identified Xbox1708 mechanism; +-5deg does not replace project<=.1deg.
sources.supervisor_checked_patent: https://patents.google.com/patent/US5724068A/en ; mechanism feasibility only, no Xbox identification or adopted preload/spring constants.
sources.native_setter: SAPIEN src/physx/articulation_link_component.cpp:220-225 -> PxArticulationJoint::setDriveParams; wheel set_drive_properties force-mode binding.

trace_join: Original trace covers500 load/release steps; shared state observer covers750 including settle. Step diagnostics contain before-step q/qvel, requested/readback K and elastic estimate, and post-step native drive readback.
